prompt: Design and code a creative agency website for 'Apex Studio'. Bold, brutalist aesthetic mixed with smooth GSAP animations. Include: a full-screen video/canvas hero, a horizontal scroll section showcasing 5 case studies, a team section with 3D tilt cards, and a contact form. Use Next.js. I need the complete project including a simple Express backend to handle the contact form submissions.

assertions.text: Creates a Next.js project structure with proper App Router layout
Uses GSAP for animations (imported or via CDN)
Implements horizontal scroll section for case studies
Implements 3D tilt card effect on team section
Includes a contact form wired to a backend endpoint
Provides an Express backend or Next.js API route for form handling
